name: Shot Cup
etsyTitle: Handmade Ceramic Shot Glass , Soda Fired, 1.5oz
description:
A small cup with a lot of character. This shot glass was wheel-thrown by hand and fired in a soda kiln to cone 10, where flame, ash, and soda vapor move through the kiln and leave their mark on every surface. The flashing and glaze variation you see were shaped by the fire as much as by me. Half me, half accident.

Because each piece is atmospheric fired, no two are alike. The one in the photos is the one you'll receive.
size: Holds approx. 1.5 oz; Measures approx. 2in x 2in
care: Food, microwave and dishwasher safe. Hand washing keeps it looking its best.
